mainText: This is the Gaza Dispatch audio briefing for June 10, 2026. Here are the key source-backed developments from today's edition. 1. Palestinians face systematic abuse by Israeli settlers and Hamas alike: Independent investigators. Palestinian civilians are trapped between escalating settler violence in the occupied West Bank and fear-based Hamas rule in the Gaza Strip, investigators appointed by the UN Human Rights Council said on Tuesday in a new report. This was reported by UN News. 2. Hamas pushes to link Gaza to Iran war deal, but many unconvinced. As Israeli attacks persist and the humanitarian toll rises, Gaza's residents are caught between diplomatic efforts and daily survival. This was reported by The New Arab. 3. Satellite images show Israel's destruction of historical city of Tyre. Satellite data shows damage to residential areas, UNESCO Heritage buffer zones and Palestinian camps in Israeli attacks. This was reported by Al Jazeera. 4. Amnesty says Israel ethnically cleansing West Bank Palestinians. Israel has forcibly displaced thousands of Palestinians from the West Bank's.
